name: CreateExpressSync

parameters.help_en: The name of the express synchronization group. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, Chinese characters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter or a Chinese character
parameters.help_zh: 极速同步组名称。同步组名称长度限制1~128个字符，可以包含大小写字母、中文、数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）或短划线（-），同时必须以大小写字母或者中文开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the express synchronization group. The description can be up to 255 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 极速同步组描述。长度限制为255个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The region where the OSS bucket is located
parameters.name: bucket_region

parameters.help_en:
The name of the bucket. Note:

You can specify only one OSS bucket for a synchronization group. All data changes in the bucket are synchronized to your on-premises environment.
If you have not created a share for the OSS bucket, you must first create a share between the file gateway and the OSS bucket
parameters.help_zh:
Bucket名称。请注意：

一个同步组只能设定一个OSS Bucket，所有对该Bucket内数据进行的改动都会被同步至本地。

如果您还未创建任何连接至OSS Bucket的共享，请先创建文件网关与OSS Bucket之间的共享
parameters.name: bucket_name

parameters.help_en: The prefix of the subdirectory in the bucket. If you want to synchronize data changes in a specific subdirectory of the bucket, you can specify the subdirectory
parameters.help_zh: Bucket子目录。如果您要对Bucket特定子目录内的数据改动进行同步，可以填写您需要的子目录
parameters.name: bucket_prefix

Code.description_en: The status code. A status code of 200 indicates that the request was successful
Code.description_zh: 状态码。状态码为200表示请求成功

ExpressSyncId.description_en: The ID of the express synchronization group

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
